description: Which US listed ETFs hold a company (a company, not a fund), ranked by weight, with the weight its issuer published and the book's date; bond funds holding its debt are listed separately. Answers "which ETFs hold X" and "which fund holds the most X". Takes a name or ticker. Covers 31,019 companies.

company.description: A company name or its exchange ticker, such as NVDA or Palantir.

limit.description: Most holders to list in each group. Default 40.

name: etf_holders

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
